instruction: Look up Dota 2 and put its official soundtrack DLC in the cart.

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding Dota 2 in Steam store and adding official soundtrack DLC to cart. Uses existing is_added_to_steam_cart metric to verify cart content. Very similar to original task with rephrased instruction.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: checking if 'The Dota 2 Official Soundtrack' is added to Steam cart
Getter (get_page_info) correctly navigates to Steam cart URL and extracts page content
Metric (is_added_to_steam_cart) correctly checks if expected item text appears in cart page content
Expected value 'The Dota 2 Official Soundtrack' is the correct official name for the Dota 2 soundtrack DLC
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the single clear goal stated in the instruction
No postconfig needed: cart state persists after navigation, getter can access it directly
Logical flow is sound: get cart page → check if item text present → return success/failure
